name: env-cap-example-tsconfig-aliases-consumer
description: Application that installs @examples/tsconfig-aliases from a real packed tarball (not a monorepo sibling) and discovers its environment contract across the package boundary via generateEnvArtifacts()'s packages option (ADR 0014) -- while its own local contract is organized through its own tsconfig.json path alias (ADR 0023), proving the two mechanisms compose.
